entities.label: Evidence
entities.summary: Papyrus 74, designated by 𝔓74, is a copy of the New Testament in Greek. It is a papyrus manuscript of the Acts of the Apostles and Catholic epistles with lacunae. The manuscript paleographically had been assigned to the 7th century. Papyrus 74 is a manuscript. Classified as Tier A (Primary Source) evidence. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
